title: HELIX Bridge: Workday Student → AcademicPeriod
description: Maps Workday Student academic period objects to the HELIX AcademicPeriod resource.

source_objects.description: A defined period of academic activity in Workday. Includes terms, sessions, and sub-terms.
The calendar structure that contains academic periods. Defines the institution's term pattern.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Map Workday period types to HELIX: 'Semester'→'semester', 'Quarter'→'quarter', 'Trimester'→'trimester', 'Session'→'session', 'Sub_Term'→'mini_term'. Reference IDs are tenant-configurable.
attribute_mappings.notes: Workday has a clean period type concept. Mapping is more straightforward than Banner or PeopleSoft.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Direct map. Workday's reference ID for the period (e.g., 'Fall_2026', '2026-2027_Semester_1').
attribute_mappings.notes: Workday reference IDs are institution-configured. Less constrained than Banner's YYYYMM pattern.

attribute_mappings.transformation: Resolve Academic_Year reference to YYYY-YYYY format.
Cast to ISO 8601 date. Workday may use 'Enrollment Freeze Date' as the census equivalent.
attribute_mappings.notes: Field name varies by Workday Student version and tenant configuration. Confirm the field used for official enrollment snapshot.

attribute_mappings.transformation: true if current date is between start_date and end_date
